name: GCH Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: GCH Technology Co., Ltd. is a producer of specialized chemical products. Its extensive catalog features clarifiers for polyolefins, various high-performance nucleators (including ß-type and PA variants), and acid scavengers suitable for both PVC and polyolefin applications. The company also supplies non-dust one-pack granular additive mixtures, preblend additives, and masterbatch additives designed for resins. Furthermore, their offerings include primary and secondary antioxidants, light stabilizers, UV absorbers, and anti-block agents. These chemical innovations are utilized across numerous industrial sectors, such as food and beverage packaging, home appliances, automotive components, toys, wire and cable manufacturing, medical supplies, artificial leather, and plastic profile fabrication. Founded in 1995, GCH Technology Co., Ltd. is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.
